item.text: {"case_id":"SHC055","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C21","C04","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C21","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C21 is the July 6 determination that the child expressly extends, and it supplies nearly the entire child memorandum’s language and operative sequence: the Governor’s request and emergency predicate, extension of the determination subject to existing conditions, rescission and termination of suspension orders if the emergency ends, EPA monitoring and reporting, preservation of EPA authority, and the 120-day limitation. The child principally updates the extension dates and adds language protecting national ambient air-quality standards. C04 and C18 are earlier iterations of the same drafting lineage but are less immediate and somewhat less complete matches.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Based on a request submitted to me by the Governor of the State of Florida to extend my July 6, 1979 determination that a regional energy emergency continues to exist in the State of Florida of such severity that a temporary suspension of certain air pollution control regulations ... may be necessary, and that other means of responding to the energy emergency may be inadequate, I hereby extend that determination","parent_excerpt":"Based on a request submitted to me by the Governor of the State of Florida to extend my June 12, 1979 determination that a regional energy emergency continues to exist in the State of Florida of such severity that a temporary suspension of certain air pollution control regulations ... may be necessary, and that other means of responding to the energy emergency may be inadequate, I hereby extend that determination","explanation":"The child reproduces C21’s distinctive opening formulation while updating the referenced determination and extension dates."},{"child_excerpt":"If, during the extension, I find that a regional energy emergency no longer exists in Florida, I will direct that this extension be rescinded, and that all suspension orders issued by the Governor be terminated on the day of that rescission.","parent_excerpt":"If, during the extension, I find that a regional energy emergency no longer exists in Florida, I will direct that this extension be rescinded, and that all suspension orders issued by the Governor be terminated on the day of that rescission.","explanation":"This operative rescission provision is identical."},{"child_excerpt":"Please continue to work with State officials to monitor carefully the residual oil supply in Florida and to inform me if the emergency should cease to exist. You will continue to retain full authority to disapprove temporary suspension of regulations in Florida and to exercise your emergency powers authority under Section 303 of the Clean Air Act, when and if necessary.","parent_excerpt":"Please continue to work with State officials to monitor carefully the residual oil supply in Florida and to inform me if the emergency should cease to exist. You will continue to retain full authority to disapprove temporary suspension of regulations in Florida and to exercise your emergency powers authority under Section 303 of the Clean Air Act, when and if necessary.","explanation":"The child copies the monitoring, notification, oversight, and emergency-authority machinery verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"It is important to keep suspensions to an absolute minimum since Section 110 (f) of the Clean Air Act limits each suspension to a maximum duration of 120 days.","parent_excerpt":"It is important to keep suspensions to an absolute minimum since Section 110 (f) of the Clean Air Act limits each suspension to a maximum duration of 120 clays.","explanation":"Apart from an apparent typographical difference, the same statutory-duration warning appears in the same place in the operative sequence."}]}
